Class ShaderInputLayoutDesc

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Aura
Assembly
OnixRuntime.dll

Represents a collection that describes the layout of input elements for a shader. Provides methods to define, modify, and enumerate the input elements used by a shader program.

public class ShaderInputLayoutDesc : IEnumerable<ShaderInputLayoutDesc.Storage>, IEnumerable

Remarks

Use this class to specify the structure of vertex or instance data that will be provided to a shader. The layout determines how input data is mapped to shader variables, which is essential for correct rendering. The collection can be modified by adding or clearing elements, and supports enumeration for inspection or processing. This class is not thread-safe.

ComputeHash()

Computes a 64-bit hash value that uniquely identifies the current shader input layout configuration.

public ulong ComputeHash()

Returns

ulong

Remarks

The computed hash reflects the current state of the shader input layout. If the layout changes, the hash value will also change. This method is typically used to efficiently compare or store shader input layouts. Note that this computes it every time, since you can also change it at any time.
